note: American Offshore Whaling Logbook Data (468,249 daily noon positions from 1,449 voyages, 1780s–1920s; compiled from the Maury abstracts, the Census of Marine Life and Townsend logbook transcriptions). Each 2° cell shows its share of all positions logged in that decade, so decades with few surviving logbooks are comparable with busy ones; frame '1910' covers 1910–1927, frame 'all' every position. Logbooks are a sample of voyages: most positions are from the 1830s–1850s.
units: share of the decade's logbook positions
